name: Beautify
description: VSCode-style beautify for the active editor buffer. Formats JSON/JSONC, JS/TS/JSX/TSX, HTML, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Jinja, CSS/SCSS/LESS/Sass, Markdown, XML/SVG, YAML, TOML and SQL via a native sidecar, including the script, style and fenced-code blocks embedded inside them. Click the wand icon next to the markdown-preview button or press Ctrl+Alt+B.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
